en.headline: Police arrest woman after boy rescued from Kwun Tong fire
en.dek: Officers said a 42-year-old woman was held on suspicion of child neglect after a blaze at Tsui Ping (North) Estate on Wednesday night.
body: Police said they arrested a 42-year-old woman on suspicion of ill-treatment or neglect of a child in her care, after a fire on Wednesday night at Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong.

Officers said the fire was reported at about 7:54pm in a flat at Chui To House. Firefighters rescued a 13-year-old boy from an air-conditioner ledge outside the flat. He was conscious when taken to United Christian Hospital. About 70 people left the building on their own.

Police said a preliminary investigation suggested an external charger in the living room started the fire, and that the case was not being treated as suspicious in that respect. Investigators later believed the boy had been left alone at the flat.
The woman was detained for inquiries. The case was being followed by the Kwun Tong district crime unit. She has been arrested and has not been charged.

zh.headline: 翠屏北邨火警後 警方拘捕42歲女子
zh.dek: 警方稱，女子涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕，正被扣查，案件交觀塘警區刑事調查隊跟進。
body: 警方表示，觀塘翠屏北邨星期三晚發生火警後，拘捕一名42歲女子，她涉嫌對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略。
警方稱，晚上約7時54分接報翠桃樓一個單位火警。消防在單位外牆冷氣機位置救出一名13歲男童，他送往基督教聯合醫院時清醒。約70人自行疏散。
警方初步調查相信客廳一個外置充電器引起火警，火警本身沒有可疑。人員其後相信男童事發時被獨留在單位內。
該名女子正被扣留調查，案件交由觀塘警區刑事調查隊第二隊跟進。她已被捕，尚未被檢控。
